# Human Rights Commission Hybrid Meeting Agenda

**Gloucester City Hall**
Council Conference Room
9 Dale Avenue
Gloucester, MA 01930
September 28, 2026
6:00 pm

The public is welcome to attend in person or remotely. A Zoom link to access the meeting remotely is also available.

Participants will need to download Zoom to their phone, tablet or computer. Join from Computer, Smart Device https://gloucester-ma-gov.zoom.us/j/86129893412

Meeting ID: 86129893412

Please visit http://gloucester-ma.gov/remote-public-meetings for instructions and guidance on how to join a remote meeting.

1. Call to order.
2. Review and approval of July 27, 2026 minutes
3. Meeting Joe Lucido, Assistant Director of Operations on City ADA compliance
4. Review HRC Student Member Recruitment Search Draft Description
5. Community updates.
6. Next Meeting: October 26

---

The listing of matters is those reasonably anticipated by the chair, which may be discussed at the meeting. Not all items may in fact be discussed and other items not listed may also be brought up for discussion to the extent permitted by law.
summary: The Human Rights Commission will meet on September 28, 2026 to review July meeting minutes, meet with the Assistant Director of Operations about City ADA compliance, and review a student member recruitment description.
